name: manage-engine-log360
label: ManageEngine Log360
description: ManageEngine Log360 is a unified SIEM solution with integrated DLP and CASB capabilities that detects, prioritizes, investigates, and responds to security threats.

fields.title: Server URL
fields.name: server_url
fields.description: Specify the URL of the ManageEngine Log360 server to connect and perform the automated operations.
fields.tooltip: Specify the URL of the ManageEngine Log360 server to which you will connect and perform the automated operations.

fields.title: Auth Token
fields.name: token
fields.description: Specify the auth token generated from API Settings page to access the ManageEngine Log360 endpoint. To generate an API key, refer to Steps to generate AuthToken on ManageEngine Log360 documentation.
fields.tooltip: Specify the auth token generated from API Settings page to access the ManageEngine Log360 endpoint.

fields.title: Verify SSL
fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.description: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.
fields.tooltip: Specifies whether the SSL certificate for the server is to be verified or not. By default, this option is selected, i.e., set to true.

operations.title: Get Events List
operations.description: Retrieves a detailed list of events from the ManageEngine Log360 server based on the search query, hosts, groups and other filter criteria that you have specified.

parameters.title: Search Query
parameters.name: query
parameters.tooltip: Specify the search query to retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the search query to retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.

parameters.title: Start DateTime
parameters.name: from
parameters.tooltip: Specify the start date and time to search and retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the start date and time to search and retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.

parameters.title: End DateTime
parameters.name: to
parameters.tooltip: Specify the end date and time to search and retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify the end date and time to search and retrieve events from ManageEngine Log360.

parameters.title: Log Host IDs
parameters.name: log_source_ids
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comma-separated list of host IDs to limit the search to these specific hosts. Maximum: 100 host IDs
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of host IDs to filter the search to these specific hosts when retrieving events from ManageEngine Log360. Maximum: 100 host IDs

parameters.title: Log Types
parameters.name: log_types
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comma-separated list of log types to limit the search to these specific log. Maximum: 100 log types
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of log types to filter the search to these specific log type when retrieving events from ManageEngine Log360. Maximum: 100 log types

parameters.title: Log Source Group IDs
parameters.name: log_source_group_ids
parameters.tooltip: Specify the comma-separated list of source group IDs to limit the search to these specific groups. Maximum: 100 group IDs
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify a comma-separated list of source group IDs to limit to filter the search to these specific groups when retrieving events from ManageEngine Log360. Maximum: 100 group IDs

operations.title: Execute an API Request
operations.description: Sends an API request to any API endpoint based on specified HTTP method, endpoint, and other input parameters that you have specified, enabling flexible API interactions tailored to user needs.

parameters.name: method
parameters.title: HTTP Method
parameters.description: Select an HTTP action for the request. You can select from the following options: DELETE GET PATCH POST PUT
parameters.tooltip: Select an HTTP action for the request. You can select from the following options: DELETE GET PATCH POST PUT

parameters.title: Endpoint
parameters.name: endpoint
parameters.tooltip: Specify the target API URL path for request.
parameters.description: Specify the target API URL path for the request. For example, if the website is https://example.com and URL path is https://example.com/api/v2/incidents/search, the endpoint would be incidents/search.

parameters.title: Query Parameters
parameters.name: params
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify any optional parameters to add to the URL and refine the request.

parameters.name: data
parameters.title: Request Payload
parameters.description: (Optional) Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
parameters.tooltip: (Optional) Specify data, as JSON, to be sent as the request payload (typically for POST or PUT requests).
